description: Blocked (stepped-on) calls per aircraft callsign in the last 60 minutes, most first. Real traffic only: simulated runs are in a different index and are never counted here.

configuration.query: FROM unstep-events | WHERE type == "AnomalyEvent" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 60 minutes | STATS blocked = COUNT(*) BY callsign | SORT blocked DESC | LIMIT 10
